watches.name: Aerodyne - The Race For Space
watches.description: A Special Edition collaboration between Marloe and Public Service Broadcasting. Inspired by the ambition, wonder, and pioneering spirit of the band's acclaimed album The Race For Space, this timepiece celebrates the remarkable achievements and enduring fascination of humanity's journey beyond Earth. Created to mark Public Service Broadcasting's special Race For Space 10+1 concert at Alexandra Palace, this edition is limited to 200 pieces. Thoughtfully designed, assembled in-house, and deeply connected to the music that inspired it, each watch is a tribute to exploration, innovation, and one of the greatest adventures ever undertaken. To further connect the watch to the music and occasion it celebrates, every presentation box is signed by all four members of Public Service Broadcasting: J. Willgoose, Esq., Wrigglesworth, JFAbraham and Mr B.

watches.name: Haggis Works - Sunny
watches.description: Something peculiar has been happening at Marloe HQ once again... The skies have brightened, the workshop has been awash with colour, and somehow, another Haggis Works creation has made its way onto the bench. It seems the Haggis have taken inspiration from the Aerodyne's muse, Amelia Earhart, with a subtle nod to Howland Island - the tiny Pacific outpost that was destined to be her next landfall, but tragically never reached. The exhibition caseback features the unmistakable clouds of the remote Pacific speck she set out to reach but never did, through which her faithful aircraft can be seen soaring onwards. But beneath the whimsy lies the same attention to detail and craftsmanship you'd expect from Marloe. Each watch is carefully assembled in-house at our Oxfordshire workshop before making its way into the world.

watches.name: Aerodyne - Pearl
watches.description: The Aerodyne Pearl carries a quieter, more reflective note within the collection - its name a gentle echo of a moment that shaped history. Mirroring the Tenee in spirit, it features a crisp white dial contrasted by black and orange accents, offering the same clear, purposeful legibility in a lighter, more understated palette. With its balanced, flieger-inspired design and softened tone, the Pearl stands as a study in restraint and clarity - an instrument watch that feels both considered and quietly distinctive.

watches.name: Aerodyne - Tenee
watches.description: The Aerodyne Tenee takes its name from Amelia Earhart’s Lockheed Electra 10E, but its character is shaped as much by the quiet precision of her navigator, Fred Noonan. The design draws on classic flieger cues yet pares them back into something more grounded and utilitarian - an instrument built not just for the cockpit, but for the map, the compass, and the long, uncertain stretches in between. With its restrained aesthetic and navigational spirit, the Aerodyne Tenee pays tribute to the disciplined craft of finding one’s way.

watches.name: Aerodyne - Navigator

Clean, functional, and easy to read at a glance, it’s a watch designed for orientation and endurance rather than ornament, embodying the calm precision required to chart a course when it matters most.

watches.name: SkySplitter - Airway

As a pilot’s watch equipped with a GMT function, the Airway carries that aviation lineage forward, offering clear, intuitive tracking of multiple time zones. watches.name: SkySplitter - Jetstream

And with its GMT capability, it goes beyond a classic pilot’s watch, giving you the ability to track a second time zone with the same instrument‑grade precision.

watches.name: Aerodyne Steel Bracelet (18mm)
watches.description: Designed exclusively for the Aerodyne, our steel bracelet offers a purposeful alternative to leather - engineered for durability, comfort, and everyday versatility. Manufactured from marine‑grade 316L stainless steel and finished in a uniform fully blasted matte (with anti-fingerprint coating) , the bracelet complements the Aerodyne’s character while remaining understated on the wrist. Solid steel links provide strength and reassuring weight, while quick‑release spring bars allow for easy, tool‑free fitting. A folding clasp features discreet Marloe engraving and, crucially, an on‑the‑go micro‑adjustment system, allowing the fit to be fine‑tuned in seconds as conditions change. Links can also be removed for sizing using a 1mm screwdriver. This is a bracelet built with intent - robust, refined, and made to work hard wherever your Aerodyne takes you.

watches.name: Aerodyne - Miami
watches.description: Inspired by Amelia Earhart’s daring circumnavigation of the globe, the Aerodyne range celebrates the spirit of early aviation and the vibrant places she touched down along the way. Miami captures that sense of energy and optimism - its palette draws from the electric glow of Miami’s neon nightlife, bringing a sense of excitement to the wrist. Its vertically brushed black dial bursts with searing hot-pink accents, climbing past a polished chamfer to a metallic turquoise chapter ring. Here, crisp black printing meets sunset-yellow hour blocks, creating a striking contrast that feels alive with colour and movement. A hot-pink seconds hand completes this bold composition - a deliciously daring twist on aviation heritage.

watches.name: Aerodyne - Electra
watches.description: The Electra is a bold variation on a theme, drawing inspiration from its flagship sister model, the Heart, and transporting us inside the Lockheed Model 10-E “Electra” aircraft that Amelia Earhart piloted on her fateful circumnavigation of the globe. As the plane soars into the twilight sky, this dial captures that fleeting moment between dusk and night. From the front, it appears jet black - stealthy and refined - but when light strikes at just the right angle, a vivid teal glow bursts forth, revealing its true character. It’s the twilight interpretation of the Heart, mysterious yet radiant. A polished chamfer frames the vertically brushed main dial, leading to a raised chapter ring painted bright white with crisp black printing and bold hot-pink hour blocks. This vibrant accent continues across the dial, outlining the numerals and striping the seconds hand counterweight - a subtle nod to aviation’s daring spirit. The Electra is a watch that thrives on contrast: darkness and light, restraint and flair, heritage and modernity - all in perfect balance.

watches.name: Aerodyne - Heart
watches.description: Polished aluminium fuselages, sleek aerodynamic forms, and the rhythmic hum of propellers cutting through the sky - these were the visions that inspired the lead dial in the Aerodyne range. Designed to capture the spirit of 1930s aviation, the Heart evokes the daring era of pioneers like Amelia Earhart. The dial features a vertically brushed aluminium surface framed by a polished chamfer, leading the eye to a vivid hot-yellow chapter ring with crisp black printing. Bold and dynamic, it reflects the energy of sun-baked concrete aprons and the gleam of freshly polished aircraft. Every detail is a tribute to the elegance and innovation of early flight - crafted for those who dream of adventure.

watches.name: Sceptre S2 - Vault
watches.description: The Sceptre’s origins lie in research into nuclear submarines and the shadow of the Cold War - one of our earliest designs was even called “October.” So when it came to reimagining the Sceptre for the S2 series, Gordon found inspiration in a different kind of retrofuturism: an atompunk world drawn from a cult-classic game and its TV adaptation. This striking colourway pays homage to the utilitarian overalls worn by those who sought refuge in the Vaults - nuclear shelters built to protect humanity after the Great War of 2077. The dial is a faded navy blue, its radiating textural lines leading to a raised, darker blue chapter ring printed with golden yellow and crisp white markings. Polished appliqué echo the unmistakable form of radiation symbols, while the outward bezel is drenched in a full golden-yellow paint fill. Bold, evocative, and otherworldly - this is a colourway that feels like it belongs to a future imagined in the past.

watches.name: Sceptre S2 - Reactor
watches.description: The blinding sunset. The raging fire. A glowing reactor. This colourway is a bold, visceral expression of what the Sceptre S2 represents - the raw power of nuclear energy and the catastrophic beauty of its misuse. It’s the apocalypse on your wrist: waves of radiation, scorched earth glowing red-hot. But just like the submarines, power stations, and the heroes our children read about, that same force transforms into something inspiring - evocative, unmistakable, and yes, even a little fun. This is our first-ever fumé dial, blending a deep burnt sienna at the edge into a searing orange core, creating a dynamic sense of heat and movement. The energy spills onto the bi-directional bezel, with one side blazing in molten orange and the other fading into the earthy glow of cooling soil. It’s a hot one - handle with care.

watches.name: Sceptre S2 - Sonar
watches.description: Deep beneath the ocean’s surface, a glowing green screen pulses with life - beeping, flashing, fading. This is SONAR: Sound Navigation and Ranging. The ocean’s proximity sensor, SONAR enables operators to track and identify undersea traffic, whether mapping the seabed, sweeping for mines, aiding search and rescue, or supporting commercial fishing. It’s the unseen language of the deep. This colourway is the boldest interpretation of the Sceptre S2. Its fumé lime dial and vivid accents make it impossible to ignore - provocative, unapologetic, and utterly unique. It may divide opinion, but its impact is undeniable. Beautiful. Brutal. Intriguing. This is the Sceptre S2 at full volume.

watches.name: Sceptre S2 - AC75

The competition fuses mastery of the sea with Formula 1-level innovation to create a spectacle of ultra-performance racing. These prototype monohulls don’t just skim the water - they soar above it on aerofoils. Equipped with soft wing sails and electrically powered hydrofoils, they can hit blistering speeds of over 55.5 knots (63 mph) - proof of why these extraordinary machines are reserved for the world’s elite sailors. A deep black dial, embossed with our new wave texture, hosts polished appliqué and a raised black chapter ring accented with teal and white markings. Surrounding it is a bi-directional bezel, finished with dual-tone paint fills - aquamarine and blazing red-mirroring the dial’s vibrant accents and the anchor-shaped counterweight on the seconds hand. Clean, bold, and unmistakably competitive.

watches.name: Sceptre S2 - Regatta

Built for life at sea - gliding effortlessly above the waves - this watch sets the tone for the new Sceptre S2 collection. Its dial is a study in clarity: a flat white surface rippled with texture, radiating toward a tall metallic-blue chapter ring, where a crisp white minute track is printed with precision. Anchored to this serene backdrop is our newly designed polished appliqué, deeply filled with Super-Luminova for uncompromising legibility. The Sceptre S2 introduces a new handset, including a hairline seconds hand in the same vivid blue as the chapter ring. Surrounding it all is a reimagined bezel, now featuring dual-color paint fills - red for port, green for starboard - a subtle nod to maritime tradition. This is the sailor’s Sceptre S2: purposeful, elegant, and ready for the open water.

watches.name: Ardnamurchan Single Cask - 10 Year

Cask 420 is a remarkable expression: a lightly peated single malt matured in a first-fill American oak hogshead, finished in a ex Pedro Ximénez sherry hogshead. The result is a whisky of exceptional depth and character - smoky and maritime, layered with notes of dark fruit, oak spice, and a lingering sweetness that speaks of its sherry heritage. watches.name: Coniston - Bluebird
watches.description: Limited Edition of 1000 Watches "Courage is not being fearless" - words spoken while pushing and breaking the boundaries of physics and human endeavour. Donald Campbell was no stranger to challenges of extreme engineering and danger. The Coniston is inspired by its namesake lake, where Donald and his father Sir Malcolm Campbell set numerous water-speed records. The name Coniston has become synonymous with Donald Campbell’s speed records and his boat, the Bluebird K7. It seemed only fitting that one of our Coniston watches should honour the striking Bluebird boat itself, and its part in these remarkable endeavours. Thus, the Coniston Bluebird was born. Taking its distinctive blue hue from the K7, the Bluebird’s central plateau and outer rehaut stand in contrast to the inset ring of lume which gives the Bluebird exceptional readability in both daylight and darker hours. A pop of yellow in the form of the second hand and second markers, inspired by the yellow of the Bluebird’s badge and intake covers, add another element of interest to the already striking face. Polished hour and minute hands and applied indices tie together with the case, while giving another subtle nod to the metallic trim found on the K7. As the boat itself proudly sported the British flag, our logo and the words ‘designed in Britain’ are unobtrusively featured on the dial in clean white, completing this most unique and distinctive of watches. The overall feel of the Coniston Bluebird evokes that bygone era of engineering prowess; thoughtfully designed, proudly British, and unwaveringly brave. Read more about the man who inspired the Coniston Bluebird, or see the rest of the collection here .

The Global is functional, yet unobtrusive, its matte blasted case echoing the dial finish and hour/minute hands. Large numerals, chamfered date window and BGW9 Superluminova offer maximum legibility. Designed for life, destined for adventure. Limited Edition map included - find out more .

watches.name: Navy Perforated Leather (20mm)
watches.description: Our Navy Perforated Strap features a padded top-grain leather with a soft Nubuck lining, matching navy stitching and an engraved Marloe icon buckle. The top-grain leather has had it's surface buffed and sanded, then pigmented, to leave the leather smooth, matte and uniform - this gives the strap high durability and strength. Our perforated straps have a 20mm lug-end which tapers to 18mm at the buckle - they also feature quick-release spring bars. Compatible with: Coniston, Astro, GMT, Haskell, Pacific, Morar 310, Glenbeg, Motorsport, Daytimer

watches.name: Coniston - White
watches.description: Classic, crisp and clean, the Coniston White is an exercise in streamlined simplicity. Polished applied indices and polished stainless steel hands, matching the case, stand out with striking clarity against the chalky central plateau. A black second hand ties in with the printed black markings indicating the seconds, minutes and hours around the outer chapter ring.

watches.name: Coniston - Vulcan
watches.description: The Coniston Vulcan is a chimera of engineering inspiration; the body of the Coniston, with the markings of the Avro Vulcan jet. Royal Air Force Grey alters with the light and with each movement of the wrist, switching from stormy grey to blue skies under the sapphire crystal. The striking turquoise second hand, logo and painted markers on the outer rehaut provide a pop of contrast, all tied together with polished applied indices and hands.

watches.name: Coniston - Steel
watches.description: The Coniston Steel is a feast of diverse textures and colour, independent and contrasting elements coming together into one striking timepiece. Radial brushing gives the metallic face its sunburst effect, creating depth and catching the eye with each movement of the wrist. Black nickel plated hour appliqués, logo and outer seconds track stand their ground in contrast to the metal, and polished hands tie the dial together with the case. A vivid red second hand and hour markers bring a pop of colour to the face; a subtle flourish in a dial full of details. A ring of Superluminova, sunken between the outer rehaut and the central plateau, provides a welcome break from the norm; using negative space and working with the lume-tipped hands to show the passing of time after dark.
